title: Run the wrapper quality gate against a frozen candidate in a clean workspace
description:
Objective: verify the code that will actually be delivered. The wrapper's optional quality gate currently runs in the shared project directory before candidate attribution and staging, so it can pass using a dirty helper file that never reaches the final commit, and a CAS retry can rebuild the candidate against an advanced tip without repeating the gate.

Deliverable: in scripts/moe-agent.sh and scripts/moe-agent.ps1, the landing path freezes the candidate tree first, records it with record_candidate, materializes that tree in a clean workspace, runs the configured gate there, reports the outcome with record_check_run, and calls finalize_attempt with the landing result. A CAS retry that rebuilds the candidate against a new tip produces a new candidate and reruns the gate rather than reusing the old result.

Not in scope: the receipt record and target-movement recheck, which is the sibling task. Keep every existing landing guarantee: pathspec-only attribution, the tier rules, rescue refs on any failure, and the refusal codes.

Both wrappers must stay in parity; scripts/tests/parity-check.sh enforces shared strings.

Verification: bash scripts/tests/postflight.sh and bash scripts/tests/parity-check.sh, on a quiet box with MOE_POSTFLIGHT_TIMEOUT_SEC=180.
definitionOfDone: Both wrappers freeze the candidate tree before running the gate and record it via record_candidate
The gate runs against the frozen tree materialized in a clean workspace, not the shared dirty project directory
The gate outcome is reported via record_check_run with the tree sha it ran against, and finalize_attempt is called with the landing result
A CAS retry against an advanced tip creates a new candidate and reruns the gate instead of reusing the previous result
Existing landing behaviour is preserved: pathspec-only attribution, tier rules, rescue refs on failure and the existing refusal codes all keep their harness coverage
bash scripts/tests/postflight.sh and bash scripts/tests/parity-check.sh both pass
The clean workspace is removed on every exit path, including gate failure and Ctrl+C
taskRails: Keep scripts/moe-agent.sh and scripts/moe-agent.ps1 in exact parity; parity-check.sh gates the shared strings.
Never use git add -A or a bare git commit; the existing pathspec-only, temp-index landing stays.
A gate failure must still route bytes to a rescue ref, never to the branch.
